raw.specification_text:
Scheme Name: PM-YASASVI Top Class Education in Schools
Ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
Department: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
Target Classes: Class 9, Class 10, Class 11, Class 12
Academic Requirement: Meritorious students who have secured admission in identified Top Class Schools (TCSs) across India.
School Type Requirement: Shortlisted/notified Top Class Schools (including top private and specialized residential schools).
Annual Income Ceiling: Rs. 250000
Selection Mode: Direct / Merit
Financial Assistance: Covers full tuition fees, hostel fees, and other non-refundable charges up to ₹75,000 per annum for Classes 9 and 10 (up to ₹1,25,000 for Classes 11-12). - Rs. 75000 per annum
Registration Requirement: One Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar/EID on NSP
raw.faq_text:
Q: Who can apply for PM-YASASVI Top Class Education in Schools?
A: Eligible students studying in Class 9, Class 10, Class 11, Class 12.
Q: What is the official portal?
A: https://scholarships.gov.in
Q: Is OTR required for AY 2026-27?
A: Yes, One Time Registration is mandatory on National Scholarship Portal.
